key_insight: QSim-Arena uses AI agents to make quantum simulation advantage assessment an evolving, reproducible process rather than a fixed comparison.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports more credible quantum resource planning by comparing fault-tolerant designs against independently crosschecked classical baselines.
method: Specify Hamiltonians, initial states and accuracy targets for evolved states or observables.
Translate published methods into executable components, reproduce results and benchmark across Hamiltonian families.
Explore combinations of classical techniques and co-design fault-tolerant quantum circuits using literature-derived knowledge.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved baseline resource estimates in initial applications through established techniques, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Improved resource estimates do not establish practical quantum advantage; conclusions depend on classical baseline strength and the validity of error bounds and empirical calibration.
paper_title: QSim-Arena: an evolving developer for quantum simulation advantage
